notes.title: Update 1.3ver - BUG Correction & Card Function Open
notes.notes:
[h1]BUG fix[/h1]
I observed that the heroine of some players will never come back. I have fixed this bug. If there is a player who encounters this situation, she will come back immediately after opening the game. If not, just look at the white cat and wait. her for a few minutes.

[h1]Optimized[/h1]
☆The sushi scene is now standing still, and the minimum income will be 200
☆Cat grass has lowered the price so that the early stage can be spent faster
☆The mouse system can now close the window by pressing the "X" button of the window

notes.title: 2022/10/14 Update 1.10ver
notes.notes:
[h1]Mouse control system installed[/h1]
Left mouse button = confirm
Right mouse button = back
Mouse wheel = zoomable room window size

[h1]Fix bug[/h1]
☆The problem that the screen resolution and full screen switch cannot be changed in the room screen
☆The problem of unable to have daily conversation when the favorability is 100%

Optimized some UI operations

If you encounter any bugs or problems, please tell me in the discussion area and I will fix it as soon as possible.
Thank you all for purchasing.
